skill.name: clinical-decision-support
skill.description: Generate clinical decision support reports for research and pharmaceutical workflows, including biomarker cohort analyses, evidence-graded treatment recommendations, decision algorithms, and publication-ready LaTeX outputs.
skill.summary: Create evidence-based clinical research reports with biomarker, outcome, and GRADE support.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by clinical vocabulary, LaTeX syntax, and Markdown backticks. The review confirms real risks in user-controlled file writes and unescaped TeX generation from user or CSV data.

remediation.issue: Unescaped user and CSV values are inserted into generated TeX.
remediation.suggestion: Escape LaTeX special characters before insertion, validate node identifiers, and warn users not to compile untrusted TeX with shell escape.

remediation.issue: Scripts write to caller-controlled output paths and directories.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve paths, reject absolute paths and parent traversal, confine outputs to a workspace directory, and require overwrite confirmation.

remediation.issue: The skill requests Bash and references optional script-based workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Document required dependencies, make external figure generation optional, and avoid automatic command execution without explicit user confirmation.

content.value_statement: Clinical research teams need structured reports that connect biomarkers, outcomes, and evidence quality. This skill produces cohort analyses, treatment recommendations, and publication-ready LaTeX documents for review workflows.
actual_capabilities: Drafts biomarker-stratified cohort analysis reports with OS, PFS, ORR, and hazard ratios.
Builds treatment recommendation reports with GRADE strength labels and evidence tables.
Generates LaTeX templates for cohort analyses, biomarker reports, treatment guidelines, and decision algorithms.
Provides Python scripts for survival analysis, cohort tables, validation checks, and TikZ decision trees.
Includes reference guidance for biomarkers, outcome analysis, evidence synthesis, and treatment sequencing.
limitations: Does not replace clinician judgment or local medical review.
Requires de-identified, authorized data before analysis.
Generated LaTeX should be reviewed before compilation or distribution.
Some scripts require Python packages that are not bundled with the skill.

use_cases.title: Analyze Trial Subgroups
use_cases.description: Create biomarker-stratified cohort summaries for efficacy, safety, and outcome comparisons across trial populations.

use_cases.title: Prepare Evidence Tables
use_cases.description: Draft GRADE-based treatment recommendations with evidence quality, recommendation strength, and decision pathways.

use_cases.title: Package Research Reports
use_cases.description: Turn de-identified cohort data into LaTeX tables, survival summaries, and publication-ready report sections.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Cohort Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a patient cohort analysis outline for a de-identified oncology cohort. Include biomarkers, outcomes, tables, figures, and review checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Biomarker Findings
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a biomarker-stratified findings section for this cohort summary. Include molecular subtypes, outcome differences, evidence caveats, and clinical implications.

prompt_templates.title: Build Treatment Recommendations
prompt_templates.prompt: Create evidence-based treatment recommendations for this disease state. Use GRADE labels, evidence tables, safety considerations, and a decision algorithm.

prompt_templates.title: Review Publication Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this clinical decision support draft for de-identification, statistical reporting, evidence grading, biomarker nomenclature, and missing sections.

best_practices: Use only de-identified data with permission for analysis.
State data sources, endpoints, statistical methods, and evidence grading assumptions.
Have qualified clinical and statistical reviewers approve outputs before distribution.
anti_patterns: Do not use generated reports as direct bedside treatment orders.
Do not include protected health information in prompts or CSV files.
Do not compile unreviewed LaTeX from untrusted data sources.

faq.question: Is this skill for individual patient care?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for group-level research reports, guideline drafts, and pharmaceutical evidence summaries.

faq.question: Can it analyze biomarker-defined cohorts?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes guidance for molecular subtypes, genomic markers, IHC markers, and biomarker-linked outcomes.

faq.question: Does it generate statistical figures?
faq.answer: It includes scripts and templates for survival curves, cohort tables, waterfall plots, and decision tree outputs.

faq.question: What data should users provide?
faq.answer: Use de-identified cohort summaries, endpoint definitions, biomarker groups, treatment exposure, and approved evidence sources.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What review is required before sharing outputs?
faq.answer: Clinical, statistical, regulatory, and privacy review should occur before publication, submission, or stakeholder distribution.
